data.one_liner: Flutter plugin to use Google's ML Kit Text Recognition on Android and iOS.
data.what_it_does: A Flutter plugin providing access to Google's ML Kit Text Recognition API. It allows your app to recognize text in Chinese, Devanagari, Japanese, Korean, and Latin character sets from input images.
use_when: You need to extract text from images or camera feeds in mobile applications
You want on-device text recognition for Chinese, Devanagari, Japanese, Korean, or Latin scripts
avoid_when: You need web or desktop support, as it is only built for mobile platforms
You need complex non-Latin script text recognition natively on iOS without fallback
strengths: Uses native Google ML Kit APIs for robust performance
Supports multiple character scripts including Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Devanagari, and Latin
weaknesses: Mobile platforms only (iOS and Android); web and desktop are not supported
Non-Latin scripts are not yet natively supported on iOS
data.setup_notes: Requires setting minimum iOS deployment target to 15.0, Swift Package Manager setup with linker flags, resource bundles for iOS, and optional Android build.gradle dependencies for specific non-Latin scripts.

alternatives.name: google_ml_kit
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides a comprehensive single package for all ML Kit features instead of separate individual packages.
